# 📝 Change Request

## Summary
Describe the requested change.

## Motivation
What problem or learning objective does it address?

## Scope
Affected exercises, docs, scripts, and workflows.

## Proposed implementation
Describe the approach and alternatives.

## Impact assessment
Include behavior, accessibility, security, compatibility, and maintenance effects.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Observable criterion.
- [ ] Documentation updated.
- [ ] Validation evidence recorded.

## Risks and rollback
List likely regressions and restoration plan.
